Its model: ~500 SKUs sold loose, without packaging — grains, nuts, spices, coffee, tea, honey, dried fruit, oils, pasta, detergents, cosmetics — with customers bringing their own containers, weighing goods and paying by weight ("Shop without packaging"). Categories span food (grains & baking, nuts & dried fruit, spices & tea) and refill liquids (oils, vinegar, honey, detergents, shampoo) plus compostable eco-goods. A small, low-profile pioneer eco-retailer with a minimal digital footprint — public data on owners and revenue is scarce, so verify current status. Bottom line: a niche manifesto-store that made package-free shopping a lifestyle in Georgia.
